{{Top|leg|title=''Maso''-class light cargo hauler}}
The '''''Maso''-class light cargo hauler''' was a class of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. The ''[[Last Legs]]'', a freighter captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Harmzuay]]'', was a ''Maso''-class.
